items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: the read section was first, uh, a fellow named Joe, I believe Joe Watson, I believe he's a clandest saxophone player... So, we worked there... that was the Pelican Band

ctx.x: And when did you go after this band broke up?

Well, as I said, we, we, in Pensacola, we were working for these people, and so, uh, we used to play a town like, like Mobile, and go to Montgomery, and, uh, there's a couple other times we'd go. So, uh, around about, uh, let's see, close to 26, well, we left Pensacola, no, we made a trip down to Florida, that's what we made, a trip all over from Pensacola to, uh, Jacksonville, Florida. Well, this guy, here in the...

he was managing the band and booking the band because they didn't have no bookies no day, but he was a man that knew a lot of people, you see. And we booked this all the way to Jacksonville. We stayed, I remember it was in the winter we were in Jacksonville, Florida. And the fella George Morris, he had been a cook one time. He suggested that we go down to Miami or Panama, way down up in there, you see. And well, the fella, they wasn't doing so good on the road and everybody wanted to get back to Pensacola, you…

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: And then he, some kind of way, he picked up on B'Bare, really. So he got in the band. Well, the band already had, they had Robert Hall, and they had another fellow named Joe Watson, that was a very good saxophone and clarinet player... So we, that band, built up to be a pretty good band on the Pelic

ctx.x: that's the one I was telling you about Caffrey that was with the band remember I mentioned their name? yeah that was with the band that when we first got there they was with another guy working for the guy up there Prince Morris but Joe Wynn had came in and picked up a group and brought us there and when we got there he took out of that band that band was composed of Lee Collin on trumpet Evan Hall on clarinet Albert Morgan on bass and Caffrey I always remember Caffrey Caffrey Dairnsbury and they had Oil on…
